_comment: FF-1 (ADR 0087 ruling 2) — shared vectors for the INSTANCE-AWARE answer map. Consumed by BOTH the SQL side (supabase/tests/20_conditions.sql, against app.overlay_answer_map) and the TypeScript mirror (src/lib/queries/conditions.test.ts, against overlayAnswerMap). Drift is phase-blocking (Rule 3). `map_vectors` pin the OVERLAY itself: `base` is the response's top-level map (answers with no group_instance_id, including a plain `group`'s children per ruling 6), `overlay` is ONE repeating-group instance's own answers, `expected` is the resolved map an item inside that instance is evaluated against. `eval_vectors` pin the DECISION end-to-end — overlay, then feed the UNCHANGED evaluator — because agreeing on the map is not the same as agreeing on the outcome, and the outcome is what gates a submit. NOTE: app.eval_condition / evalCondition are deliberately UNTOUCHED by FF-1; they are already pure over a map, so the entire instance dimension lives in map construction and the 11 operators need no re-proof.

map_vectors.name: disjoint keys merge (an instance child sees the top-level answers)
same-instance sibling WINS over a top-level key of the same name
a key in NEITHER map stays absent (no fallback to another instance)
an explicit JSON null in the overlay is PRESENT-with-null, not absent
an explicit JSON null in the overlay shadows a real top-level value
checkbox arrays REPLACE wholesale, never merge element-wise
numbers and booleans survive the overlay unchanged

eval_vectors.name: inside-out: a same-instance sibling satisfies the condition
inside-out: a same-instance sibling with a different value does not
sibling ABSENT in this instance is absent — equals is false, NOT inherited
sibling ABSENT in this instance — not_equals is true (missing-answer semantics)
sibling ABSENT in this instance — is_empty is true
a TOP-LEVEL answer is visible from inside an instance
the instance value shadows the top-level one for the evaluator
ordered ops work against an instance value
checkbox membership works against an instance array
an instance array does not leak into a sibling instance's decision
